# Python
import pandas as pd
exp = pd.read_csv("data/journey_exp.csv")
exp_clean = exp[exp.attn_1 == 1]
print(exp_clean.groupby("cond").mil.agg(["mean", "std", "count"]))
#           mean       std  count
# cond
# 0     4.980874  1.271103    183
# 1     5.263661  1.180114    183

# Python
from scipy import stats
a = exp_clean[exp_clean.cond == 1].mil
b = exp_clean[exp_clean.cond == 0].mil
t, p = stats.ttest_ind(a, b)
print(round(t, 3), round(p, 4))
# 2.206 0.028

# Python: 이 책은 손으로 짠 도우미를 쓴다 (14장 §14.2)
b, se, p, r2 = ols(exp_clean.mil, [exp_clean.cond])
print(round(b[1], 4), round(se[1], 4), round(float(p[1]), 4), round(r2, 4))
# 0.2828 0.1282 0.028 0.0132

# 실무판 (코랩 기본 제공)
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
print(smf.ols("mil ~ cond", data=exp_clean).fit().summary())
